title: Environmental Justice Cumulative Burden Explorer
description: Interactive concept map showing six archetypal U.S. environmental-justice hotspots with clickable detail panels and a configurable EJScreen-style burden threshold.
creator: Introduction to Public Health Project
subject: public health
environmental health
environmental justice
EJScreen
cumulative burden
learningObjective: Students can describe how cumulative exposure burden combines environmental hazards with demographic vulnerability and explain how the choice of percentile threshold shapes which communities qualify for intervention.

controls.label: Cumulative Burden Threshold
controls.purpose: Filters which hotspots are highlighted as 'burdened' based on illustrative EJScreen percentile.

controls.label: Reset
controls.purpose: Clears the selected hotspot detail panel and returns the threshold to 0.

assumptions: The six hotspots are archetypal representations of well-documented EJ communities; positions on the simplified U.S. outline are illustrative.
EJScreen percentiles shown are plausible illustrative values, not live EPA EJScreen pulls.
Demographic and exposure descriptors are simplified summaries of published characterizations.
limitations: Not a substitute for live EJScreen analysis at a specific census tract.
Six hotspots are not exhaustive; many other EJ communities exist across the U.S.
Stylized polygon does not represent actual state borders or geography.
